# 1. Celebrate the Ludi Saeculares (15-year repeatable grand festival + event oe_romp.521)
oe_v50_romp_dec_ludi_saeculares = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_v50_romp_dec_ludi_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_ludi_cd }
		}
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 15 }
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_v50_romp_dec_ludi_saeculares.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_v50_romp_dec_ludi_saeculares_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_ludi_cd value = 1 years = 15 }
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
			culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 5 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.521
		}
	}
}

# 2. Invoke the Sibylline War & State Oracle (10-year repeatable 3-option prophecy -> oe_romp.522)
oe_v50_romp_dec_sibylline_oracle = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_v50_romp_dec_sibylline_cd_tt
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_sibylline_cd }
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 12 }
		if = { limit = { at_war = yes } add = { value = 15 } }
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:clergy_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_v50_romp_dec_sibylline_oracle.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_v50_romp_dec_sibylline_oracle_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_sibylline_cd value = 1 years = 10 }
			add_religious_influence = religious_influence_weak_bonus
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.522
		}
	}
}

# 3. Decree the Imperial Cult of the Divus (permanent philosophical/civic choice -> oe_romp.523)
oe_v50_romp_dec_imperial_apotheosis = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v50_romp_apotheosis_decreed }
	}
	allow = {
		prestige >= 25
		stability >= 0
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 25 }
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_v50_romp_dec_imperial_apotheosis.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_v50_romp_dec_imperial_apotheosis_tt
			set_variable = { name = oe_v50_romp_apotheosis_decreed value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp.523
		}
	}
}
